nodes.name: Petrine Primacy
nodes.label: Petrine Primacy
nodes.definition: The belief that the Bishop of Rome holds primacy as successor to Saint Peter.

nodes.name: Apostolic Succession
nodes.label: Apostolic Succession
nodes.definition: Concept that episcopal authority derives from a continuous line of succession from the apostles.

nodes.name: Martyrdom as Witness
nodes.label: Martyrdom as Witness
nodes.definition: Early Christian idea of bearing witness through suffering, shaping Roman Church identity.

nodes.name: Papal Primacy Doctrine
nodes.label: Papal Primacy Doctrine
nodes.definition: Late antique articulation of the Pope's jurisdictional authority within the universal Church.

nodes.name: Christological Orthodoxy
nodes.label: Christological Orthodoxy
nodes.definition: Doctrinal commitments on the nature of Christ affirmed at ecumenical councils.

nodes.name: Latin Church Identity
nodes.label: Latin Church Identity
nodes.definition: The cultural and liturgical self-understanding of the Western Church centered on Rome.

nodes.name: Papal Monarchy
nodes.label: Papal Monarchy
nodes.definition: Medieval concept of the Pope as supreme spiritual ruler with temporal influence.

nodes.name: Canon Law Tradition
nodes.label: Canon Law Tradition
nodes.definition: System of church law codified and interpreted by papal and conciliar authority.

nodes.name: Scholastic Reason–Faith Synthesis
nodes.label: Scholastic Reason–Faith Synthesis
nodes.definition: Intellectual approach integrating philosophical reason with theological doctrine.

nodes.name: Tridentine Catholicism
nodes.label: Tridentine Catholicism
nodes.definition: Post–Council of Trent doctrinal and liturgical standardization emphasizing discipline and catechesis.

nodes.name: Baroque Sacred Aesthetics
nodes.label: Baroque Sacred Aesthetics
nodes.definition: Artistic idea using grandeur, drama, and emotion to inspire devotion and convey doctrine.

nodes.name: Papal Diplomacy
nodes.label: Papal Diplomacy
nodes.definition: Concept of the Holy See as a diplomatic actor mediating between Catholic powers.

nodes.name: Ultramontanism
nodes.label: Ultramontanism
nodes.definition: 19th-century movement emphasizing papal authority and centralized governance of the Church.

nodes.name: Catholic Social Teaching
nodes.label: Catholic Social Teaching
nodes.definition: Doctrine on social justice, labor, and human dignity articulated by papal encyclicals.

nodes.name: Sovereign Holy See
nodes.label: Sovereign Holy See
nodes.definition: Idea of the Holy See as a sovereign subject of international law distinct from Vatican City.

nodes.name: Ecumenism and Interreligious Dialogue
nodes.label: Ecumenism and Interreligious Dialogue
nodes.definition: Contemporary commitment to unity among Christians and dialogue with other faiths.

nodes.name: Human Dignity and Rights
nodes.label: Human Dignity and Rights
nodes.definition: Modern Catholic teaching emphasizing the dignity of every person and social justice.

nodes.name: Synodality
nodes.label: Synodality
nodes.definition: Idea of shared discernment and participation in Church governance emphasized in recent decades.
